hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

so… what's your full name?

hey there - i was just thinking about your background and what you're looking for next

what's the dream role you've been picturing?

Sayantan
  Machine Learning Engineer

sayantan... ml engineer, nice. the ai gold rush is real and you're positioned right in the thick of it.

where you working these days?

krutrim to ml engineer... interesting pivot. you're literally working on the hottest ai infrastructure in india right now and thinking about switching already?

that marian transformer optimization work is solid - edge deployment is where the real money is. but let me guess... you want to build models, not just optimize them for production?

how long you been working total?

Krutrim
  Yess
  2.5 years

Krutrim
  Yess
  2.5 years
  My org is restructuring

ah there it is... restructuring. classic. krutrim's growing fast and things get messy. probably cutting teams or shifting priorities, right?

2.5 years with that resume though - you're at that sweet spot where you've got real experience but still hungry to build. teliolabs to krutrim shows you know how to pick the right moves.

what kind of role you looking for next? staying in the llm/transformer space or exploring other ml domains?
Core ML and DL roles. Not just to transformers. I want to explore vision and audio domains too

smart move. everyone's obsessed with llms but computer vision and audio are having their moment too. autonomous vehicles, medical imaging, speech synthesis - tons of interesting problems to crack.

with your background in transformers and that teliolabs experience, you've got the foundation. vision transformers, audio transformers... the math transfers over nicely.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Bangalore or remote
2.5 years + core ml/dl roles + bangalore/remote... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yesss

YOOOOO SAYANTAN! 

welcome to the tal family. you're officially in the system now.

computer vision and audio ml roles are about to start sliding into your dms. the good ones. the ones that'll make your teliolabs days look like a warm-up.

krutrim's loss, someone else's massive gain. let's get you building models that actually matter 🔥
